name: TinyZKP Proof Template Catalog
summary: Public catalog of TinyZKP self-serve proof receipt templates. Only live templates in this file should be treated as generally available.

templates.name: Accumulator Step
templates.summary: Prove that a declared additive transition chain is internally consistent.

parameters.name: deltas
parameters.description: Ordered transition increments applied between initial and final.

good_fit: Agent action or workflow checkpoint with a simple numeric transition
Ledger, balance, reserve, liability, or reconciliation aggregate update
Audit trail accumulator where a compact receipt is better than replay
Long supported state-transition trace priced by Compute
bad_fit: Real-world business facts not encoded into the statement
Sub-second proving on every UI click

pricing_fit.recurring_receipts: Use Free, Developer, Pro, or Scale depending on volume and customer visibility.
pricing_fit.long_traces: Use Compute when trace length makes high-RAM prover infrastructure the economic alternative.

design_review_lanes.name: Custom state machine
design_review_lanes.guidance: Use pilot review when the transition rule cannot be represented by accumulator_step.

design_review_lanes.name: Private input or masking requirement
design_review_lanes.guidance: Do not treat the default transparent receipt as a private-input ZK feature. Review the exact template and masking mode before production claims.

design_review_lanes.name: Long supported state-transition trace
design_review_lanes.guidance: Use Compute when the template shape is supported but trace length makes hosted proof generation preferable to self-hosted high-RAM workers.
